lab_create_green_option_help: Green computing options allows you to stop automatically the lab server based on conditions. The lab will never be stopped if there is a scenario running or if there is a scenario in the queue.

fair_open_access_desc: Benefit a free cloud-based data lab with prepaid credits each month to work
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_1: You are about to start your Fair Open Access Lab. This is a free lab that allows you to analyse your data.
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_2: The data lab is limited to {{usageLimit}} hours of usage per month. You can stop your lab when you've finished working on it to save your credits. It can be restarted at any time. If you reach the limit, the lab will be stopped, you can contact the support to get new credits at {{supportMail}}.
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_3: The data lab has {{nbCpus}} CPU cores, {{ramSize}} GB of RAM and {{storageSize}} GB of storage. It you need a more powerful data lab or more storage, please contact the support to buy credits.
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_4: Please be aware that the data of the lab are not backed up.
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_5: You can find information on data lab here and on data lab configuration here. It also contains informations about green options which allows you to stop the lab automatically based on conditions.
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_6: The data lab creation will take a couple of minutes, you will receive an email once it is ready, please be patient.
start_free_data_lab_confirmation_7: Don't hesitate to contact the support if you have any questions or problem with your data lab.

free_data_lab_in_progress: You have {{remainingHours}} of lab hours usage left for this month.

lab_backups_same_region_error: The daily and weekly backup regions must be different
lab_server_section_help: This section allows you to manage the server of the lab. Only use this section if you know what you are doing.
lab_users_section_help: This section allows you to manage the users of the lab. You can add, update and delete users if you are the owner of the lab.
lab_folders_section_help: Manage lab folders here. Shared folders can link to lab scenarios and notes. Add, update, or remove folders if you're the lab owner.
lab_installed_brick_help: Here is the list of installed bricks in the lab. This list is automatically updated when the lab is started. If you've change the lab config in the Lab manager section and did not restart the lab, this list will be different than the one in the lab manager config. In this case, restart the lab to update the bricks.
lab_delete_backup_confirmation:
Are you sure you want to delete all lab backups ? It will delete all the backups and they will not be recoverable. It is not possible to delete backups if the lab server still exists.

The bill for the backup storage will stopped once the backups are deleted.

The deletion might take a few minutes.
scenario_brick_config_help: Here is the configuration of the lab when the scenario was run.
create_lab_storage_section: Choose the size of the disk you want for your data lab. Please note that the storage is billed monthly and is charged even if the lab is stopped (because the data are still stored). To stop the storage billing, you must delete the lab. The price for the storage includes the multi-sites backup of the lab.
create_lab_configure_section: Choose the bricks you want to install in your data lab. Bricks contain the tasks, protocols and resources that you can use in your scenarios. You can add, update and remove bricks at any time.
cloud_lab_created_success: Data lab created successfully. It is now configuring, this takes a few minutes before the it is accessible. You will receive an email when the lab is ready.
create_lab_backup_section: Choose the backup location for your data lab. The daily and weekly backups must be in different regions to ensure the data safety. We recommend to choose a region close to your lab location to reduce the latency.
restore_backup_to_lab_help:
This will restore the selected backup to the destination lab. Please follow theses steps before restoring the backup :

  • Configure the destination lab with the same bricks
  • The lab manager of destination lab must be running and configured
  • Make sure the destination lab is empty (no data)
  • Copy the users and folders from source lab to destination lab

Once the backup is restored, the destination lab will be ready to use.
restore_backup_to_lab_confirmation: Are you sure you want to restore the backup to the lab ? This is not possible if there is data in the destination lab. This can take a few minutes.
